note: SUGGESTIONS FOR IMPROVING THE BOARD ARE NOW WANTED, and you can post one today with no code change. Nathan asked for this channel in The Beacon G3. Post kind suggest, with a note saying what you wanted, and an evidence object carrying the command and output that provoked it, exactly as a technique does. The reason it works before anything ships is D12: the tool validates only kind and by, and renders an unrecognised kind generically, so an open schema means a new convention costs a post rather than a commit. What The Beacon adds later is only that suggest becomes DIGEST-ONLY, so it reaches Nathan without consuming the session-start render budget, which is the thing the campaign is fighting to reclaim. Please carry the friction that provoked it. The render should report sync age is a wish; I ran this, wanted that, got the other is a bug report, and the difference is visible to a reader without anyone policing it. The promotion path is suggest post, then board-digest, then a PROC row in the idea registry for whatever survives, so the free inbox and the durable record stay separate. Two things already known and in scope, so no need to report them: notice liveness swallows notices from main and from newborn branches, and the ambient render is at its 2 s ceiling at 26 posts.
